name: centrifugal_brine_pump_refsim
title: Centrifugal brine pump reference simulation model (RefSim)
summary: Reference simulation of a centrifugal pump on a hydraulic network: dimensionless characteristic curves (cubic psi(phi) and Lambda(phi) polynomials) with brine properties from the ULiège BrineProp library; computes pressure rise, shaft power, efficiency and exhaust state.
language_features: user-library procedure BRINEPROP (implicit library, copied in the file; string arguments, IF ladders)
LOOKUP$ (unit labels in a lookup table)

origin.course: ULiège model bank (Laborelec toolkit lineage), Model data bank, 2008-02-18

verification.summary: Compared with the solution stored in the original EES file: 32 common variables, 0 differ (rtol=0.001), maximum relative deviation 2.75e-07 (rounding of decoded table coefficients).
verification.reference: EES stored solution of the source file (44 variables)
verification.notes: 32 common variables, 0 differ (rtol=0.001); max relative deviation 2.75e-07 (P_dynam_periph_pump), then 6.4e-08 (DELTAP_pump, W_dot_shaft_pump), from the 80-bit to 64-bit rounding of the hand-decoded Brine1/Brine2 coefficient tables (rho_pump 2.9e-09, c_p_pump 6.2e-09). The two EES-only variables (b, v) are dead leftovers of an earlier version of the equations; the three CoolSolve-only variables are brine$, pi and the auxiliary output of the CALL expression :c_p_pump/1000.

related_external: BrineProp library of the ULiège model bank (Brineprop.lib, Brine1.lkt, Brine2.lkt; inventory candidate TM-0479)
